text: I hired a freelance developer from an online platform last year and the code was terrible. My colleague had a similar experience with a different freelancer from the same site. That proves it: freelance developers are unreliable and produce low-quality work. Any company that outsources to freelancers is asking for trouble. You are much better off hiring a full-time team, no matter the cost.
